nodes.label: Charge State Recovery
nodes.rationale: Recovers charge fields for anchors whose older activation history proves prior use, preserving backward compatibility.

nodes.label: Adjusted Calendar Day
nodes.rationale: Defines a product day as 02:00 through 01:59 so after-midnight sessions count toward the previous day.

nodes.label: Developer Master Account
nodes.rationale: Provides a development-only, comped Pro identity with onboarding already completed.

nodes.label: Expensive SVG Animation Gating
nodes.rationale: Gates decorative SVG animation by platform and physical pixel capacity to avoid dropped frames on budget Android devices.

nodes.label: Central Entitlement Policy
nodes.rationale: Keeps Free, Trial, and paid Pro access rules in one layer so screens do not branch directly on subscription providers.

nodes.label: Privacy-Safe Anchor Redaction
nodes.rationale: Removes intentionText from profile display and substitutes category-based labels with an ID suffix fallback.
